name: Media Genie Support
author: pujidesign

sections.description:
Media Genie Support helps streamline your WordPress media management workflow:

  • Automatically renames image files upon upload for better organization and SEO.
  • Lets you choose which image sizes WordPress should generate — avoiding unnecessary files and saving storage.
  • Supports optional Retina (2×) image generation for high-resolution displays.

Lightweight, efficient, and seamlessly integrated into your media upload process.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/media-genie/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tool > Media Genie to configure plugin options.
sections.faq:
Will this affect existing images?

No. The plugin only renames and processes images uploaded after activation.

How does Retina image support work?

If enabled, the plugin generates a @2x version of each selected image size.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Auto-rename uploaded image files.
  • Selectively generate image sizes.
  • Retina (2×) image support.
